statement: The EIA Cushing WTI crude spot price for 2026-11-20, as carried in FRED series DCOILWTICO, is at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel. Reference: 95.81 on the packet date 2026-10-20.
resolution: FRED series DCOILWTICO observation dated 2026-11-20 is at or above 100.00 (reference 95.81 on 2026-10-20). If no observation is posted for that date, the nearest prior observation governs.
failure_condition: The DCOILWTICO observation for 2026-11-20, or the nearest prior observation if that date is missing, is below 100.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: Salesforce completes its announced acquisition of Braze Inc between 2026-10-20 and 2027-03-31, with closing of the merger reported in an 8-K on SEC EDGAR.
resolution: An 8-K filed on SEC EDGAR by Braze Inc or Salesforce Inc with a filing date between 2026-10-20 and 2027-03-31 inclusive reports completion of the acquisition of Braze by Salesforce.
failure_condition: No 8-K with a filing date on or before 2027-03-31 reports completion of the Salesforce acquisition of Braze, whether because the deal is still pending, renegotiated, or terminated.

statement: France declares a state of emergency under the law of 3 April 1955 for all or part of its territory in response to the current unrest, with the decree published in the Journal officiel between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: A decree declaring a state of emergency under the law of 3 April 1955 for any part of French territory appears on Legifrance (Journal officiel) with publication date between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: No decree declaring a state of emergency under the law of 3 April 1955 carries a Journal officiel publication date between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-20; curfews, troop deployments and prefectoral orders alone do not satisfy the condition.

statement: Democratic candidates win a majority (at least 218 of 435 seats) of the US House of Representatives in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: AP race calls as of the deadline show Democratic candidates winning at least 218 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election; uncalled races and pending runoffs count as not won.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates have been called winners in fewer than 218 US House seats as of 2026-12-04.

statement: Russia and Ukraine sign a ceasefire, armistice or peace agreement covering the entire line of contact between 2026-10-20 and 2027-01-29, with the signing confirmed by both governments.
resolution: Both the Russian and Ukrainian governments publicly confirm that authorized representatives signed a ceasefire, armistice or peace agreement covering all front lines between 2026-10-20 and 2027-01-29, as reported by both Reuters and AP.
failure_condition: As of 2027-02-02 no ceasefire, armistice or peace agreement covering all front lines has been signed and confirmed by both the Russian and Ukrainian governments; partial, local or energy-only truces do not count.

statement: The United States and Iran announce or sign a ceasefire, cessation-of-hostilities or framework agreement between 2026-10-20 and 2026-12-31 that both governments publicly confirm.
resolution: The US and Iranian governments each publicly confirm the same ceasefire, cessation-of-hostilities or framework agreement between the two countries, announced or signed between 2026-10-20 and 2026-12-31, as reported by both Reuters and AP.
failure_condition: As of 2027-01-05 there is no single ceasefire, cessation-of-hostilities or framework agreement announced or signed between 2026-10-20 and 2026-12-31 that both Washington and Tehran have publicly confirmed; unilateral pauses and mediator claims do not count.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one Siemens entry with a date-added value between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-20, following the reported in-the-wild exploitation of a Siemens Software Center flaw.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one entry whose vendorProject field contains the string Siemens and whose dateAdded value falls between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog contains no entry with vendorProject containing Siemens and dateAdded between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-20, including if the flaw was catalogued before 2026-10-21 or never catalogued.

statement: A ransomware or data-extortion group claims the Ahold Delhaize cyberattack by publishing a leak-site listing naming Ahold Delhaize or one of its retail banners between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-30 a leak-site listing by a ransomware or extortion group names Ahold Delhaize or one of its retail banners, as reported by at least two of BleepingComputer, The Record, SecurityWeek, Reuters.
failure_condition: No ransomware or extortion group publishes a leak-site listing naming Ahold Delhaize or one of its retail banners between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-30.

statement: Tommy Robinson (Stephen Yaxley-Lennon) is convicted, by jury verdict or guilty plea, on at least one count in the London Crown Court trial in progress on 2026-10-20 concerning alleged harassment of journalists, with the conviction recorded between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-27.
resolution: A guilty verdict or guilty plea against Tommy Robinson on at least one count in the London journalist-harassment trial is recorded between 2026-10-20 and 2026-11-27 inclusive, as reported by at least two of BBC, Guardian, PA Media, Reuters.
failure_condition: No guilty verdict or guilty plea on any count in the trial is recorded by 2026-11-27; acquittal on all counts, a hung or discharged jury, a mistrial, or an adjournment past the window all make this a MISS.

statement: USGS catalogs at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with epicenter within 250 km of the 2026-10-20 M6.3 Vanuatu event (USGS id us6000u3jl) and origin time between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: The USGS ComCat earthquake catalog contains at least one event with magnitude 6.0 or greater, epicenter within 250 km of event us6000u3jl, and origin time between 2026-10-21 00:00 UTC and 2026-11-20 23:59 UTC.
failure_condition: No USGS-catalogued event of magnitude 6.0 or greater with epicenter within 250 km of us6000u3jl has an origin time between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-20.
